text: {"id":"explore","title":"Share of response bytes by service","viz":"pie","description":"Computes each service's share of total response bytes, grouped by service, in bytes.","query":{"sourceId":"eval-demo","sql":"SELECT service, SUM(bytes) AS total_bytes FROM http_requests GROUP BY service ORDER BY total_bytes DESC"},"layout":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":12,"h":4},"format":"bytes","options":{"unit":"bytes","compact":true,"legend":"right"}}
